# Visa Employer Watch

> A free, public research site over U.S. Department of Labor records: every employer that filed an H-1B (LCA) or H-2B visa application in fiscal year 2025, and the Wage and Hour Division (WHD) enforcement cases linked to those employers. Every number traces back to a DOL record ID.

AI tools can query the data through a read-only MCP server. No account or key is needed.

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP): https://visa-employer-watch.onrender.com/mcp
- The server's `initialize` reply includes instructions on what each field means. Read them before answering.
- The free hosting plan sleeps after about 15 idle minutes, so the first request after a quiet spell can take up to a minute.

## MCP tools

- `search_employers`: find employers by company name, trade name (DBA) or 9-digit tax ID (FEIN)
- `get_employer`: one employer's details, linked WHD cases, top jobs and offered against prevailing wages
- `list_applications`: an employer's visa applications, newest first
- `get_application`: one application by its DOL case number, such as I-200-25126-941960
- `watchlist`: employers with linked WHD cases, ranked and filtered by program, state, industry and year
- `state_stats` and `industry_stats`: per-state and per-industry counts and rates
- `data_overview`: totals for the whole database

## What the data means

- WHD cases cover every law WHD enforces (minimum wage, overtime, child labor, H-1B, H-2B and others), not only visa violations. `get_employer` lists, for each case, the laws violated with violations, back wages, workers owed and penalties under each; WHD publishes counts, not a description of what happened.
- WHD records have no tax ID, so cases are linked to employers by cleaned name plus ZIP code or state. About 3 to 4 percent of links are wrong in a tax-ID test.
- `get_employer` includes any matching entry on DOL's published debarment lists. Debarment is a DOL finding; the match to the employer is by name (and state when DOL gives one).
- The willful violator field is the employer's own Yes/No answer on its applications, not a DOL finding.

## Pages to cite

- Employer: https://visa-employer-watch.onrender.com/#/employer/<employer_id>
- Application: https://visa-employer-watch.onrender.com/#/application/<case_number>
- Watchlist: https://visa-employer-watch.onrender.com/#/watchlist
- DOL debarments, matched to filers: https://visa-employer-watch.onrender.com/#/debarments

## JSON API

- https://visa-employer-watch.onrender.com/docs: interactive documentation for the read-only JSON API that the website uses
